tokens.build.reason: Requested-scope JSON and CSS resolve brand/theme. Full CSS retains every built scope; TypeScript and Tailwind artifacts explicitly retain legacy A/light defaults.

brand.apply.reason: A failed real token build returns OODS-S019 with captured output and receipts. Source writes are deliberately left in place for inspection and repair; no automatic rollback is claimed.

brand.intake.reason: Read-only intake emits an envelopeHash and a consumable delta only for fully accepted inline A/B documents with unique mapped themes. No brand creation, persistence or content-reference resolver is claimed.

fidelity.preview.anchor: const scope = { brand: canonicalBrand(brand), theme: 'light' as const };
fidelity.preview.reason: Non-production branded mockups resolve canonical built A/B light tokens. brand-a/brand-b aliases are deprecated for one release; unknown brands fail explicitly.

map.anchor: records and resolves mappings for external consumers; no composer or generator consumes them
map.reason: Map records and resolves mappings for external consumers. No composer/codegen consumer; preferred_terms and disambiguation_decisions are surfaced, not consumed by resolution.

health.reason: Token theme/brand fields report environment defaults, not an observed active consumer scope.

design.preview.reason: Requires the local design-loop server in this checkout and a browser runtime; unavailable dependency returns OODS-N019.

viz.compose.reason: Deprecated field-name scaffold; it is not the real data-bound renderer or a certifiable artifact.

review.reason: The chain accepts only server-resident allow-listed fixtures.
patch is a policy decision label; this label alone is not evidence of applying a patch to canonical source.

code.generate.reason: Release validation checks caller-supplied evidence envelopes and artifact-hash consistency; it does not rerun the referenced external proof.

pipeline.reason: The generation release profile accepts caller evidence envelopes; format/hash checks do not independently execute their proof.

registry.snapshot.reason: Draft preferred terms, review decisions and capabilities are surfaced losslessly, not consumed by mapping resolution or generation.
